modules.name: Access Management
modules.purpose: Controls who can use Sentinel and what each person can see and do. The System Administrator adds, edits, restricts, deactivates, deletes and restores users, assigns roles and sets permissions; every user manages their own profile. Sign-in security rules (password every 90 days, lock after 3 failed attempts) are set and monitored here.
modules.users: System Administrator (full control); Head of Risk (approves sensitive role changes); every user (own profile and password).
panels: User list with status, role, last sign-in, password age and MFA, with filters and bulk actions

User, reason, since, unlock or reset
rules: Add: administrator creates the user; the user receives an invitation with a temporary password valid 48 hours and must change it at first sign-in
Restrict: each role has View, Create, Edit, Delete, Approve and Export per module plus a data scope (own function, business unit, all); permissions can be time-bound
Deactivate keeps history; delete moves the user to the Recycle Bin for 90 days and permanent removal needs a second approver; restore is one click
Password changes every 90 days (warnings at 14, 7 and 1 day); 3 consecutive failed attempts lock the account; unlock by administrator or reset link by e-mail
The administrator cannot view risk data unless also granted a business role; role changes for Head of Risk and Administrator need MD approval; break-glass access is time-boxed and logged
ai: Suggests role scopes from job title and peers; flags unusual access for review
Administrator assigns roles from the role list
reqs: Add, edit, deactivate, delete, restore and bulk-import users
